description: This file contains API utility functions for fetching various user insights data from backend endpoints, including activity, trends, engagement, organizational grouping, compliance, and KPIs. It exports multiple asynchronous functions that wrap HTTP GET requests with parameter cleaning and error handling.

methods.name: cleanParams(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to remove undefined, null, and empty string keys from the parameters object.

methods.name: handleApiError(error, fallbackMessage)
methods.description: Standardized error handler that wraps axios errors into a consistent Error object, attaching status, details, and axios error flag.

methods.name: getUsersActivity({ period, from, to, tenant_id } = {})
methods.description: Fetches user activity summaries over a specified period, with optional date range and tenant filtering.

methods.name: getUsersTrends({ from, to, granularity } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves trends of active users over the last 30 days with optional granularities and date filters.

methods.name: getUsersEngagementTrend({ from, to, granularity, tenant_id } = {})
methods.description: Fetches engagement trends including active users and sessions, optionally scoped by tenant.

methods.name: getUsersByOrganizations({ from, to, tenant_id } = {})
methods.description: Provides counts of active users grouped by organization, with optional date range and tenant scope.

methods.name: getUsersByDepartments({ from, to, tenant_id } = {})
methods.description: Provides counts of active users grouped by department, with optional date range and tenant scope.

methods.name: getUsersCompliance({ tenant_id, inactiveDays, requiredFields, includeDetails } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves user compliance metrics such as MFA status, inactivity, and acceptance, with optional tenant filter.

methods.name: getUsersKpis({ from, to, tenant_id } = {})
methods.description: Fetches KPI metrics such as new, active, returning users, and average sessions in a specified time window.
